nodes.label: Codebase Integrity & Free Tooling Rules
nodes.rationale: Guarantees zero-cost, local-first AST analysis with no mandatory paid external APIs.

nodes.label: Archify AST Analysis Research
nodes.rationale: Evaluates Archify's rule-based AST engine and establishes how BugBuddy adapts it for browser-based interactive AST debugging.

nodes.label: AST Debugging & Pattern Matcher
nodes.rationale: Uses Tree-sitter and AST-grep WebAssembly for client-side, zero-latency syntax checking.

nodes.label: Minecraft Survival Metaphor
nodes.rationale: Mapping code issues to Minecraft mobs (Creepers=syntax errors, Skeletons=type errors, Endermen=async leaks, Ender Dragon=memory leaks) creates intuitive mental models.

nodes.label: AI System Prompt & Coding Directives
nodes.rationale: Enforces strict developer persona, deterministic AST AST-grep rules, and Minecraft vocabulary consistency across AI assistance sessions.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Documentation Audit
nodes.rationale: Validates the existing codebase status and documents gaps before feature implementation.

nodes.label: BugBuddy Core Overview
nodes.rationale: Gamifying developer debugging using Minecraft survival mechanics transforms tedious bug-fixing into engaging gameplay.
